items.exampleEn: My phone has a stopwatch, a calculator and an alarm clock.
items.exampleZh: 我的手機有碼錶、計算機和鬧鐘功能。

items.exampleEn: A young skateboarder from our town is now famous online.
items.exampleZh: 我們鎮上一位年輕的滑板選手現在在網路上很有名。

items.exampleEn: Judo comes from Japan and focuses on throws and balance.
items.exampleZh: 柔道源自日本，著重摔技和平衡。

items.exampleEn: Our school is training five students for next year's physics olympiad.
items.exampleZh: 我們學校正在為明年的物理奧林匹亞競賽培訓五位學生。

items.exampleEn: The cat made a gymnastic leap from the sofa to the top of the shelf.
items.exampleZh: 那隻貓像體操選手般一躍，從沙發跳上架子頂端。

items.exampleEn: The horse quickly outdistanced the others and won easily.
items.exampleZh: 那匹馬很快就把其他馬甩在後頭，輕鬆獲勝。

items.exampleEn: She moved to Hong Kong to study a martial art with a famous teacher.
items.exampleZh: 她搬到香港，跟著一位知名老師學武術。

items.exampleEn: Tourists visit Olympia to see the ruins of ancient temples.
items.exampleZh: 遊客到奧林匹亞參觀古老神殿的遺跡。

items.exampleEn: Our school's debate team reached the semi-final for the first time.
items.exampleZh: 我們學校的辯論隊首次打進準決賽。

items.sentenceEn: The ancient games were held at Olympia in Greece.
items.sentenceZh: 古代的運動會在希臘的奧林匹亞舉行。

items.audioEn: The semi-final starts at three, so let's meet at the gate at half past two.
items.audioZh: 準決賽三點開始，我們兩點半在門口碰面吧。

items.sentenceEn: The coach clicked the stopwatch as soon as the runner crossed the line.
items.sentenceZh: 跑者一越過終點線，教練就按下碼錶。

items.sentenceEn: My brother has been learning judo since he was seven.
items.sentenceZh: 我的兄弟從七歲開始學柔道。

items.stemEn: My cousin teaches a ____ called judo at the sports center.
items.stemZh: 我表哥在運動中心教一種叫柔道的武術。

items.stemEn: In the last lap, the young runner ____ everyone else and won by twenty meters.
items.stemZh: 最後一圈，那位年輕跑者把其他人遠遠甩在後頭，領先二十公尺獲勝。

items.passageEn: Last summer, our sports club visited a youth sports camp. In the morning, we watched a judo class where children practiced falling safely. Next door, a martial arts teacher showed some impressive kicks. In the gym, girls showed their gymnastic skills with ribbons and balls to rhythmic music, while a coach timed the runners outside with a stopwatch. A teenage skateboarder showed us tricks in the park, and our guide, who once won a science olympiad, told us about the history of the games at Olympia. Later, we watched the semi-final of a junior soccer tournament. One fast player outdistanced every defender to score. It was a wonderful day.
items.passageZh: 去年夏天，我們運動社去參觀了一個青少年運動營。早上，我們看了一堂柔道課，孩子們在練習安全倒地。隔壁，一位武術老師示範了幾個厲害的踢腿。體育館裡，女孩們隨著節奏感強的音樂，拿著彩帶和球展現體操技巧，戶外則有教練拿著碼錶為跑者計時。一位十幾歲的滑板少年在公園裡表演花式動作給我們看，曾在科學奧林匹亞競賽得獎的導遊也跟我們介紹了奧林匹亞古代運動會的歷史。後來，我們看了一場青少年足球錦標賽的準決賽。一位速度很快的球員甩開所有後衛射門得分。那是美好的一天。

questions.questionZh: 柔道課上孩子們在練習什麼？
那位速度很快的球員做了什麼？

items.promptZh: 我們用碼錶記錄每位游泳選手的時間。
referenceEn: We used a stopwatch to record each swimmer's time.
We timed every swimmer with a stopwatch.
rubricZh: stopwatch 是可數名詞（例如 a stopwatch）
時態合理即可（例如 use、used）

items.promptZh: 那位滑板選手沿著樓梯扶手滑了下來。
referenceEn: The skateboarder slid down the handrail of the stairs.
The skateboarder rode all the way down the stair handrail.
rubricZh: skateboarder 指「玩滑板的人、滑板選手」（例如 the skateboarder 等）
「沿著扶手滑下來」可寫，例如 slid down the handrail、rode down the handrail 等
時態用過去式或現在完成式（例如 slid、rode 等）
